reason: After exhaustive reasoning over all possible byte array inputs—including nulls, empty arrays, arrays of equal and unequal lengths, and arrays with matching or differing contents—both methods exhibit identical behavior. Method2’s loop guard `more && i < val1.length` ensures that `val1.length` is never accessed when either array is null or lengths differ, preventing any NullPointerException. Consequently, no concrete input can distinguish the return value, side effects, or exception behavior of `method1` and `method2`.
